description.ar: صمم خدمة rate limiting موزعة لـ API gateway
description.en: Design a distributed rate limiting service for an API gateway

problemStatement.ar: عايزينك تصمم نظام rate limiting لـ API عام. لازم تدعم حدود per-user وper-IP، bursts معقولة، وردود 429 واضحة. الـ decision لازم يبقى سريع جدًا لأنه على الـ critical path.
problemStatement.en: Design a rate limiting system for a public API. Support per-user and per-IP limits, reasonable bursts, and clear 429 responses. Decisions must be very fast because they sit on the critical path.

prompt.ar: قبل التصميم: اسأل عن الـ scope (per-user/IP/key)، الـ algorithms، والـ accuracy vs latency. اعمل حسبة للـ QPS.
prompt.en: Before designing: ask about scope (per-user/IP/key), algorithms, and accuracy vs latency. Estimate QPS.

text.ar: سألت عن الوحدة: per API key، per user، per IP، ولا global?
text.en: Asked about unit: per API key, per user, per IP, or global?

ar.why: الوحدة بتحدد الـ key design والـ storage.
ar.how: اسأل: هل الـ limits مختلفة لكل tier؟ هل في burst؟
ar.tradeoffs: Global أبسط بس مش عادل. Per-key أدق بس أكتر keys.
ar.examples: Stripe: per API key. Cloudflare: per IP + bot score.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تفترض per-IP بس وتنسى shared NAT في الشركات.

en.why: The unit drives key design and storage.
en.how: Ask: different limits per tier? Are bursts allowed?
en.tradeoffs: Global is simpler but unfair. Per-key is precise but more keys.
en.examples: Stripe: per API key. Cloudflare: per IP + bot score.
en.mistakes: Mistake: assuming per-IP only and forgetting corporate shared NAT.

text.ar: قدّرت الـ decision QPS: ~1M peak checks/sec على الـ edge
text.en: Estimated decision QPS: ~1M peak checks/sec at the edge

ar.why: الرقم بيحدد Redis shards وgateway capacity.
ar.how: 100M DAU × 100 req/day ÷ 86400 × peak 3 ≈ مئات الآلاف؛ APIs تقدر توصل مليون.
ar.tradeoffs: Over-estimate بيغلي التكلفة. Under-estimate بيعمل denies غلط تحت الضغط.
ar.examples: AWS API Gateway، Kong، Envoy rate-limit service.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تحسب average بس وتنسى الـ peak factor.

en.why: The number sizes Redis shards and gateway capacity.
en.how: 100M DAU × 100 req/day ÷ 86400 × peak 3 ≈ hundreds of thousands; APIs can hit a million.
en.tradeoffs: Over-estimate inflates cost. Under-estimate causes bad denies under load.
en.examples: AWS API Gateway, Kong, Envoy rate-limit service.
en.mistakes: Mistake: using average only and forgetting the peak factor.

text.ar: وضّحت accuracy requirement: exact ولا approximate (±5% OK)?
text.en: Clarified accuracy: exact or approximate (±5% OK)?

ar.why: Exact محتاج sync أقوى. Approximate يسمح local counters.
ar.how: اسأل الـ product: هل 5% over-limit مقبول في الـ burst؟
ar.tradeoffs: Exact أدق وأغلى. Approximate أرخص وأسرع.
ar.examples: Redis INCR exact. Local token buckets + sync approximate.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تعد exact من غير ما تحدد clock/consistency model.

en.why: Exact needs stronger sync. Approximate allows local counters.
en.how: Ask product: is 5% over-limit acceptable during bursts?
en.tradeoffs: Exact is more precise and costlier. Approximate is cheaper and faster.
en.examples: Redis INCR exact. Local token buckets + sync approximate.
en.mistakes: Mistake: promising exact without a clock/consistency model.

text.ar: سألت عن soft vs hard limit وسلوك الـ 429 (Retry-After)
text.en: Asked about soft vs hard limits and 429 behavior (Retry-After)

ar.why: الـ UX والـ client SDKs بتعتمد على الـ headers.
ar.how: رجّع X-RateLimit-Remaining وRetry-After. Soft: warn قبل hard deny.
ar.tradeoffs: Hard فوري يحمي النظام. Soft أحسن للـ DX.
ar.examples: GitHub API headers. Stripe 429 + idempotent retries.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: 429 من غير Retry-After → clients بتعمل thundering herd.

en.why: UX and client SDKs depend on the headers.
en.how: Return X-RateLimit-Remaining and Retry-After. Soft: warn before hard deny.
en.tradeoffs: Hard protects the system immediately. Soft is better for DX.
en.examples: GitHub API headers. Stripe 429 + idempotent retries.
en.mistakes: Mistake: 429 without Retry-After → clients stampede.

prompt.ar: اوصف gateway + rate-limit service + Redis counters. وضّح decision path للـ allow/deny.
prompt.en: Describe gateway + rate-limit service + Redis counters. Explain the allow/deny decision path.

text.ar: 📊 الرسم: Client → LB → API Gateway → Rate Limiter → Redis → Backend
text.en: 📊 Diagram: Client → LB → API Gateway → Rate Limiter → Redis → Backend

ar.why: الـ check لازم يبقى قبل الـ expensive work.
ar.how: Gateway يستدعي limiter sync. Allow → forward. Deny → 429.
ar.tradeoffs: Inline middleware أبسط. Sidecar/service أدق للـ shared policy.
ar.examples: Envoy ratelimit service + Redis. Kong rate-limiting plugin.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تعمل limit بعد الـ DB query — اتأخرت وخسرت capacity.

en.why: The check must happen before expensive work.
en.how: Gateway calls limiter sync. Allow → forward. Deny → 429.
en.tradeoffs: Inline middleware is simpler. Sidecar/service is better for shared policy.
en.examples: Envoy ratelimit service + Redis. Kong rate-limiting plugin.
en.mistakes: Mistake: limiting after the DB query — too late, capacity already spent.

text.ar: Algorithm: Token Bucket مع burst + refill rate
text.en: Algorithm: Token Bucket with burst + refill rate

ar.why: Token bucket بيسمح بـ bursts مع متوسط مضبوط.
ar.how: خزّن tokens + last_refill في Redis. Lua script للـ atomicity.
ar.tradeoffs: Fixed window أرخص بس فيه boundary burst. Sliding أدق وأغلى.
ar.examples: AWS، Cloudflare، وNginx كلهم بيدعموا token/leaky variants.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: fixed window من غير ما تذكر الـ double-burst عند الحدود.

en.why: Token bucket allows bursts with a controlled average.
en.how: Store tokens + last_refill in Redis. Lua script for atomicity.
en.tradeoffs: Fixed window is cheaper but has boundary bursts. Sliding is precise and costlier.
en.examples: AWS, Cloudflare, and Nginx all support token/leaky variants.
en.mistakes: Mistake: fixed window without mentioning double-burst at boundaries.

text.ar: Redis key design: rl:{scope}:{id}:{window} مع TTL
text.en: Redis key design: rl:{scope}:{id}:{window} with TTL

ar.why: الـ key schema بيحدد cardinality والـ memory.
ar.how: TTL = window + jitter. Hash tags للـ clustering لو multi-key.
ar.tradeoffs: Fine keys أدق. Coarse keys أوفر في الـ memory.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: مفاتيح من غير TTL → memory leak.

en.why: Key schema determines cardinality and memory.
en.how: TTL = window + jitter. Hash tags for clustering on multi-key ops.
en.tradeoffs: Fine keys are precise. Coarse keys save memory.
en.mistakes: Mistake: keys without TTL → memory leak.

text.ar: Fail policy واضحة: fail-open تحت Redis outage للـ read path العام، fail-closed للـ auth-sensitive
text.en: Clear fail policy: fail-open on Redis outage for public reads, fail-closed for auth-sensitive

ar.why: الـ availability vs abuse tradeoff لازم يتقال صراحة.
ar.how: Circuit breaker على Redis. Local short cache للـ last decision.
ar.tradeoffs: Fail-open يحمي UX. Fail-closed يحمي النظام من الهجمات.
ar.examples: Payments: fail-closed. Public CDN assets: fail-open.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: fail-open لكل حاجة وقت هجوم — النظام بينهار.

en.why: Availability vs abuse tradeoff must be stated explicitly.
en.how: Circuit breaker on Redis. Local short cache of last decision.
en.tradeoffs: Fail-open protects UX. Fail-closed protects against attacks.
en.examples: Payments: fail-closed. Public CDN assets: fail-open.
en.mistakes: Mistake: fail-open for everything during an attack — system collapses.

prompt.ar: إزاي تـ scale مع hot keys والـ multi-region؟ اتكلم عن sharding والـ eventual consistency للـ counters.
prompt.en: How do you scale with hot keys and multi-region? Cover sharding and eventual consistency of counters.

text.ar: Shard Redis by key hash؛ isolate hot VIP keys على dedicated nodes
text.en: Shard Redis by key hash; isolate hot VIP keys on dedicated nodes

ar.why: Hot celebrity keys بتكسر shard واحد.
ar.how: Consistent hashing. Local in-process limiter قدام Redis للـ hottest keys.
ar.tradeoffs: Local limiter يزوّد approximation. Global Redis أدق.
ar.examples: Twitter/X style local + global hybrid limits.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: shard واحد لكل الـ counters.

en.why: Hot celebrity keys melt a single shard.
en.how: Consistent hashing. Local in-process limiter in front of Redis for hottest keys.
en.tradeoffs: Local limiter adds approximation. Global Redis is more accurate.
en.examples: Twitter/X style local + global hybrid limits.
en.mistakes: Mistake: one shard for all counters.

text.ar: Multi-region: regional counters + optional global budget sync
text.en: Multi-region: regional counters + optional global budget sync

ar.why: Cross-region RTT يقتل الـ latency لو كل check global.
ar.how: 80% budget محلي، 20% global reserved. Sync كل ثواني.
ar.tradeoffs: Regional أرخص وأسرع. Global أدق ضد abuse عابر للقارات.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: Redis واحد globally sync لكل request.

en.why: Cross-region RTT kills latency if every check is global.
en.how: 80% budget local, 20% global reserved. Sync every few seconds.
en.tradeoffs: Regional is cheaper/faster. Global is better against cross-region abuse.
en.mistakes: Mistake: one global Redis sync on every request.

text.ar: Horizontal gateway scale؛ sticky ليس مطلوب لو state في Redis
text.en: Horizontal gateway scale; stickiness not required if state is in Redis

ar.why: Stateless gateways تـ scale بسهولة.
ar.how: Autoscaling على CPU + 429 rate. Shared Redis cluster.
ar.tradeoffs: Local-only state محتاج sticky sessions.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تخزن counters في memory الـ pod من غير sync.

en.why: Stateless gateways scale easily.
en.how: Autoscale on CPU + 429 rate. Shared Redis cluster.
en.tradeoffs: Local-only state needs sticky sessions.
en.mistakes: Mistake: storing counters in pod memory without sync.

prompt.ar: إيه الـ metrics والـ alerts: allow rate، deny rate، Redis latency، clock skew؟
prompt.en: What metrics and alerts: allow rate, deny rate, Redis latency, clock skew?

text.ar: SLIs: decision latency p99، allow/deny ratio، Redis error rate
text.en: SLIs: decision latency p99, allow/deny ratio, Redis error rate

ar.why: من غير SLIs مش هتعرف الإساءة من الـ outage.
ar.how: Prometheus histograms + alerts على spike في deny أو latency.
ar.tradeoffs: Tight SLOs بتزوّد false alerts.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تراقب QPS بس وتنسى deny ratio.

en.why: Without SLIs you cannot tell abuse from outage.
en.how: Prometheus histograms + alerts on deny or latency spikes.
en.tradeoffs: Tight SLOs increase false alerts.
en.mistakes: Mistake: watching QPS only and ignoring deny ratio.

text.ar: Alert على clock skew بين nodes أكتر من 100ms
text.en: Alert on clock skew between nodes > 100ms

ar.why: Sliding window وTTL بيعتمدوا على الوقت.
ar.how: NTP monitoring. Prefer Redis TIME أو logical tokens.
ar.tradeoffs: Logical clocks أعقد. NTP أبسط لو منضبط.
ar.examples: Use Redis server time in Lua scripts.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تعتمد على client clock في الـ windowing.

en.why: Sliding windows and TTLs depend on time.
en.how: NTP monitoring. Prefer Redis TIME or logical tokens.
en.tradeoffs: Logical clocks are more complex. NTP is simpler if healthy.
en.examples: Use Redis server time in Lua scripts.
en.mistakes: Mistake: trusting client clocks for windowing.

text.ar: Dashboards per tenant/tier لـ quota burn rate
text.en: Dashboards per tenant/tier for quota burn rate

ar.why: الـ enterprise customers محتاجين شفافية.
ar.how: Export remaining quota metrics. Warn عند 80% burn.
ar.tradeoffs: Per-tenant cardinality غالية — sample أو aggregate.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: مفيش رؤية للـ customer → support tickets كتير.

en.why: Enterprise customers need transparency.
en.how: Export remaining quota metrics. Warn at 80% burn.
en.tradeoffs: Per-tenant cardinality is expensive — sample or aggregate.
en.mistakes: Mistake: no customer visibility → many support tickets.

prompt.ar: فين الـ bottlenecks: Redis hotspot، network RTT، clock sync، false positives؟
prompt.en: Where are bottlenecks: Redis hotspot, network RTT, clock sync, false positives?

text.ar: Redis hotspot على مفتاح مشهور أو VIP tenant
text.en: Redis hotspot on a famous key or VIP tenant

ar.why: مفتاح واحد يقدر يشبع CPU لـ shard.
ar.how: Local rate cache، key salting، أو dedicated shard.
ar.tradeoffs: Salting يقلل accuracy عبر الـ subkeys.
ar.examples: Hot-key replication في Redis Cluster proxies.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تزود replicas من غير ما تعالج الـ write hotspot.

en.why: One key can saturate a shard CPU.
en.how: Local rate cache, key salting, or dedicated shard.
en.tradeoffs: Salting reduces accuracy across subkeys.
en.examples: Hot-key replication in Redis Cluster proxies.
en.mistakes: Mistake: adding replicas without fixing the write hotspot.

text.ar: Network RTT بين gateway وRedis في path حرج
text.en: Network RTT between gateway and Redis on the critical path

ar.why: كل request بيستنى الـ limiter.
ar.how: Co-locate gateway وRedis. Pipeline / local approximation.
ar.tradeoffs: Local approximation أسرع وأقل دقة.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: Redis في region تانية للـ sync checks.

en.why: Every request waits on the limiter.
en.how: Co-locate gateway and Redis. Pipeline / local approximation.
en.tradeoffs: Local approximation is faster and less accurate.
en.examples: Sidecar Redis in the same AZ.
en.mistakes: Mistake: Redis in another region for sync checks.

text.ar: False positives من shared NAT / carrier-grade NAT
text.en: False positives from shared NAT / carrier-grade NAT

ar.why: آلاف المستخدمين ورا IP واحد.
ar.how: Prefer API keys/user ids. Soft limits على IP.
ar.tradeoffs: IP limits لسه مفيدة ضد bots غير المسجّلين.
ar.examples: Mobile apps: device attestation + user token.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: hard IP ban يعدّي على شركة كاملة.

en.why: Thousands of users behind one IP.
en.how: Prefer API keys/user ids. Soft limits on IP.
en.tradeoffs: IP limits are still useful against anonymous bots.
en.examples: Mobile apps: device attestation + user token.
en.mistakes: Mistake: hard IP ban taking down an entire company.

prompt.ar: Token bucket vs sliding window vs fixed window. Accuracy vs memory vs latency.
prompt.en: Token bucket vs sliding window vs fixed window. Accuracy vs memory vs latency.

text.ar: Fixed window vs sliding window vs token bucket
text.en: Fixed window vs sliding window vs token bucket

ar.why: كل algorithm ليه cost/accuracy profile مختلف.
ar.how: Fixed: INCR+TTL. Sliding: ZSET. Token: Lua tokens+refill.
ar.tradeoffs: Fixed أرخص. Sliding أدق. Token أفضل للـ bursts.
ar.examples: API Gateways غالبًا token bucket. Analytics APIs sliding.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تختار algorithm من غير workload shape.

en.why: Each algorithm has a different cost/accuracy profile.
en.how: Fixed: INCR+TTL. Sliding: ZSET. Token: Lua tokens+refill.
en.tradeoffs: Fixed is cheaper. Sliding is precise. Token is best for bursts.
en.examples: API Gateways often token bucket. Analytics APIs sliding.
en.mistakes: Mistake: choosing an algorithm without the workload shape.

text.ar: Centralized Redis vs gossip/local limits
text.en: Centralized Redis vs gossip/local limits

ar.why: المركزية vs الـ edge latency.
ar.how: ابدأ Redis مركزي. لو edge-heavy، hybrid.
ar.tradeoffs: Central أدق. Edge أسرع وأقرب للـ user.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: gossip من غير bound على over-limit.

en.why: Centralization vs edge latency.
en.how: Start with central Redis. If edge-heavy, hybrid.
en.tradeoffs: Central is accurate. Edge is faster and closer to users.
en.mistakes: Mistake: gossip without a bound on over-limit.

text.ar: Sync check vs async sampling
text.en: Sync check vs async sampling

ar.why: Sync يحمي بدقة. Async أرخص على الـ path.
ar.how: Critical writes: sync. Bulk reads: sample + soft enforce.
ar.tradeoffs: Async ممكن يعدّي spikes قصيرة.
ar.examples: Ads bidding: sync. Metrics ingest: async.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: async على payment authorize.

en.why: Sync protects accurately. Async is cheaper on the path.
en.how: Critical writes: sync. Bulk reads: sample + soft enforce.
en.tradeoffs: Async can let short spikes through.
en.examples: Ads bidding: sync. Metrics ingest: async.
en.mistakes: Mistake: async on payment authorize.

prompt.ar: الـ interviewer بيسأل: إزاي تعمل distributed rate limit من غير single Redis؟
prompt.en: Interviewer asks: how do you do distributed rate limiting without a single Redis?

text.ar: Distributed limit من غير Redis: sticky + local أو Dynomite/CRDT counters
text.en: Distributed limit without Redis: sticky + local or Dynomite/CRDT counters

ar.why: أحيانًا Redis مش available أو غالي.
ar.how: CRDT PN-counters أو approximate count-min sketch.
ar.tradeoffs: CRDTs أعقد في الـ ops. Sticky أبسط وأقل fairness.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تقول 'مستحيل' من غير alternatives.

en.why: Sometimes Redis is unavailable or expensive.
en.how: CRDT PN-counters or approximate count-min sketch.
en.tradeoffs: CRDTs are ops-heavy. Sticky is simpler and less fair.
en.mistakes: Mistake: saying 'impossible' without alternatives.

text.ar: Per-endpoint budgets مختلفة وpriority classes
text.en: Different per-endpoint budgets and priority classes

ar.why: مش كل الـ endpoints سواسية.
ar.how: Separate buckets: auth، read، write، admin.
ar.tradeoffs: أكتر buckets = أكتر config complexity.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: quota واحد يخنق login مع الـ list APIs.

en.why: Not all endpoints are equal.
en.how: Separate buckets: auth, read, write, admin.
en.tradeoffs: More buckets = more config complexity.
en.mistakes: Mistake: one quota choking login with list APIs.

text.ar: Idempotent clients: احترم Retry-After وقدّم jitter
text.en: Idempotent clients: honor Retry-After and add jitter

ar.why: الـ server لوحده مش كفاية وقت الـ 429 storms.
ar.how: SDK: exponential backoff + jitter + respect headers.
ar.tradeoffs: عدواني SDK يضغط أكتر. محافظ يبطّئ recovery perception.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: retry فوري على 429.

en.why: Server alone is not enough during 429 storms.
en.how: SDK: exponential backoff + jitter + respect headers.
en.tradeoffs: Aggressive SDKs add pressure. Conservative ones feel slow.
en.mistakes: Mistake: immediate retry on 429.

prompt.ar: قدّر تكلفة Redis clusters والـ gateway compute عند 1M QPS peak.
prompt.en: Estimate Redis cluster and gateway compute cost at 1M peak QPS.

text.ar: Redis memory: ~key_count × 200B؛ 50M active keys ≈ 10GB → cluster cost
text.en: Redis memory: ~key_count × 200B; 50M active keys ≈ 10GB → cluster cost

ar.why: Memory هو غالب تكلفة الـ limiter.
ar.how: Estimate cardinality = active identities × windows. Add replica factor.
ar.tradeoffs: Sliding ZSET أغلى من counter بسيط.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تنسى replicas وsnapshots في الـ bill.

en.why: Memory is usually the limiter's dominant cost.
en.how: Estimate cardinality = active identities × windows. Add replica factor.
en.tradeoffs: Sliding ZSET costs more than a simple counter.
en.mistakes: Mistake: forgetting replicas and snapshots in the bill.

text.ar: Gateway compute: 1M QPS ÷ 50k QPS/instance ≈ 20 instances + HA
text.en: Gateway compute: 1M QPS ÷ 50k QPS/instance ≈ 20 instances + HA

ar.why: الـ sync check بيزوّد CPU على الـ path.
ar.how: Load-test Lua/Redis RTT. Size من p99 مش average.
ar.tradeoffs: أكتر instances = أعلى availability وcost.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: sizing من average QPS بس.

en.why: Sync checks add CPU on the path.
en.how: Load-test Lua/Redis RTT. Size from p99 not average.
en.tradeoffs: More instances = higher availability and cost.
en.mistakes: Mistake: sizing from average QPS only.

text.ar: Cost controls: shorter windows، approximate counters، tiered accuracy
text.en: Cost controls: shorter windows, approximate counters, tiered accuracy

ar.why: مش كل tenant محتاج exact global.
ar.how: Free tier: fixed window. Enterprise: sliding exact.
ar.tradeoffs: Complexity في الـ product packaging.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: exact sliding لكل العملاء من يوم 1.

en.why: Not every tenant needs exact global.
en.how: Free tier: fixed window. Enterprise: sliding exact.
en.tradeoffs: Complexity in product packaging.
en.mistakes: Mistake: exact sliding for all customers from day 1.

prompt.ar: Abuse: spoofed IPs، shared NAT، credential stuffing. إزاي تحمي من bypass؟
prompt.en: Abuse: spoofed IPs, shared NAT, credential stuffing. How do you prevent bypass?

text.ar: Bind limits to authenticated identity مش IP لو ممكن
text.en: Bind limits to authenticated identity rather than IP when possible

ar.why: IP spoofing وCGNAT بيضعفوا IP limits.
ar.how: API keys / OAuth client ids كـ primary bucket.
ar.tradeoffs: Anonymous endpoints لسه محتاجة IP/device signals.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: trust X-Forwarded-For من غير trusted proxy.

en.why: IP spoofing and CGNAT weaken IP limits.
en.how: API keys / OAuth client ids as primary bucket.
en.tradeoffs: Anonymous endpoints still need IP/device signals.
en.mistakes: Mistake: trusting X-Forwarded-For without a trusted proxy.

text.ar: Protect limiter itself من amplification (auth on admin, separate plane)
text.en: Protect the limiter itself from amplification (auth on admin, separate plane)

ar.why: لو المهاجم ضرب Redis، كل الـ limits تقع.
ar.how: Private network، IAM، rate-limit الـ management APIs.
ar.tradeoffs: عزل أقوى = ops أثقل.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: Redis مكشوف على internet.

en.why: If an attacker hits Redis, all limits fall.
en.how: Private network, IAM, rate-limit the management APIs.
en.tradeoffs: Stronger isolation = heavier ops.
en.mistakes: Mistake: Redis exposed to the internet.

text.ar: Audit denials للـ security investigations من غير PII زائد
text.en: Audit denials for security investigations without excess PII

ar.why: الـ deny logs مهمة ضد credential stuffing.
ar.how: Log key hash + endpoint + reason. Retention محدودة.
ar.tradeoffs: أكتر logs = privacy risk وstorage cost.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تخزن tokens كاملة في الـ logs.

en.why: Deny logs matter against credential stuffing.
en.how: Log key hash + endpoint + reason. Limited retention.
en.tradeoffs: More logs = privacy risk and storage cost.
en.mistakes: Mistake: storing full tokens in logs.

prompt.ar: لو Redis region وقع، إيه الـ fail-open vs fail-closed policy؟
prompt.en: If the Redis region fails, what is the fail-open vs fail-closed policy?

text.ar: Multi-AZ Redis مع automatic failover؛ RPO≈0 للـ counters الحديثة مش ضروري
text.en: Multi-AZ Redis with automatic failover; RPO≈0 for recent counters is not mandatory

ar.why: Counter loss قصير غالبًا مقبول.
ar.how: Use managed Redis HA. Document cold-start budgets.
ar.tradeoffs: أقوى durability أغلى وممكن يبطّئ writes.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تعامل counters زي payment ledger.

en.why: Brief counter loss is usually acceptable.
en.how: Use managed Redis HA. Document cold-start budgets.
en.tradeoffs: Stronger durability is costlier and can slow writes.
en.mistakes: Mistake: treating counters like a payment ledger.

text.ar: Region failover playbook: default fail-closed للـ sensitive، degrade quotas
text.en: Region failover playbook: default fail-closed for sensitive, degrade quotas

ar.why: الـ DR لازم يحدد سلوك الـ limit صراحة.
ar.how: Runbook: switch DNS، warm regional Redis، temporary lower global cap.
ar.tradeoffs: Fail-open أثناء DR خطر لو الهجوم هو السبب.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: مفيش playbook → onboard on-call يرتجل.

en.why: DR must explicitly define limit behavior.
en.how: Runbook: switch DNS, warm regional Redis, temporary lower global cap.
en.tradeoffs: Fail-open during DR is risky if the cause is an attack.
en.mistakes: Mistake: no playbook → on-call improvises.

text.ar: Chaos test: Redis latency injection وتتبع 429/5xx ratios
text.en: Chaos test: Redis latency injection and track 429/5xx ratios

ar.why: الـ circuit breaker لازم يتأكد قبل الحادثة.
ar.how: GameDay ربع سنوي. Validate headers وclient SDKs.
ar.tradeoffs: أكتر chaos = أكتر engineering time.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: أول مرة تجرب failover في production حقيقي.

en.why: Circuit breakers must be proven before an incident.
en.how: Quarterly GameDay. Validate headers and client SDKs.
en.tradeoffs: More chaos = more engineering time.
en.mistakes: Mistake: first failover attempt is a real production incident.

rangeHint.ar: معامل الذروة المعتاد حوالي ٢–٤× متوسط الحمل.
rangeHint.en: Typical peak factor is about 2–4× average load.

rangeHint.ar: عداد بسيط غالبًا ١٠٠–٤٠٠ بايت مع metadata.
rangeHint.en: A simple counter is usually 100–400 bytes with metadata.

rangeHint.ar: Gateway واحد غالبًا عشرات الآلاف QPS حسب الـ Lua/RTT.
rangeHint.en: One gateway often handles tens of thousands of QPS depending on Lua/RTT.
Redis replicas for HA are usually 2–3.

steps.ar: 1) Average QPS = peak ÷ peak factor. Checks/day = avg × 86400.
steps.en: 1) Average QPS = peak ÷ peak factor. Checks/day = avg × 86400.

steps.ar: 2) Redis memory ≈ active keys × bytes × replicas.
steps.en: 2) Redis memory ≈ active keys × bytes × replicas.

steps.ar: 3) Gateways = peak QPS ÷ capacity per instance.
steps.en: 3) Gateways = peak QPS ÷ capacity per instance.

description.ar: Cluster الـ counters مش بيرد. الـ API لسه شغال. تفتح ولا تقفل؟
description.en: Counter cluster is not responding. API is still up. Fail open or closed?

checklist.ar: طبّق fail policy حسب حساسية الـ endpoint
checklist.en: Apply fail policy by endpoint sensitivity

checklist.ar: افتح circuit breaker وقلل TTLs المحلية
checklist.en: Open circuit breaker and shorten local TTLs

checklist.ar: Alert فوري + status page لو الـ denies اتأثرت
checklist.en: Immediate alert + status page if denials are affected
After recovery: reconcile and review the spike

description.ar: عميل enterprise واحد بيعمل 20% من الـ checks على مفتاح واحد. الـ latency طالعة.
description.en: One enterprise client is 20% of checks on one key. Latency is climbing.

checklist.en: Local/edge limiter in front of the key

checklist.ar: Temporary lower burst للـ tenant مع تواصل
checklist.en: Temporary lower burst for the tenant with communication

expectedNote.ar: Exact للمالية/auth؛ approximate كويس للـ edge العام.
expectedNote.en: Exact for billing/auth; approximate is fine for public edge.

whenOtherWins.ar: اختار exact لو التكلفة المالية للـ overage عالية.
whenOtherWins.en: Choose exact if the financial cost of overage is high.

question.ar: وقت Redis down: fail-open ولا fail-closed؟
question.en: When Redis is down: fail-open or fail-closed?

expectedNote.ar: يعتمد على حساسية الـ endpoint؛ غالبًا سياسة مختلطة.
expectedNote.en: Depends on endpoint sensitivity; usually a mixed policy.

whenOtherWins.en: Fail-closed for pay/login, fail-open for public content.

question.ar: Algorithm: token bucket ولا sliding window؟
question.en: Algorithm: token bucket or sliding window?

expectedNote.ar: Token bucket أوضح للـ bursts في معظم الـ APIs.
expectedNote.en: Token bucket is clearer for bursts in most APIs.

whenOtherWins.ar: Sliding لو الـ product بيحاسب بالثانية بدقة صارمة.
whenOtherWins.en: Sliding if the product bills with strict per-second accuracy.

caption.en: LB routes to the API/gateway that owns rate-limit policy

Circuit breaker opens according to policy

Audit/alert emitted to queue and on-call
